# workflows

## Purpose
GitHub Actions workflows for CI (tests/build) and publishing.

## Key Files

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `ci.yml` | Continuous integration workflow (build/test checks). |
| `publish.yml` | Publish/release workflow. |

## For AI Agents

### Working In This Directory
- Workflow edits can affect releases and CI gating. Keep changes minimal and explicit.

### Testing Requirements
- Validate YAML syntax and confirm triggers/permissions match intent.
